name: Dr. Murph
source: Dr. Murph is a comedy-oriented adult visual novel presented in a hand-drawn cartoon art style. Built around a mission-based structure, it follows the eccentric Dr. Murph and a recurring cast — Amber, Lana, Puffa, Repa and Silvia — through a series of light-hearted, absurdist episodes, with puzzle minigames interspersed between scenes.
translation: 《墨菲博士》是一部以喜剧为主的成人视觉小说，以手绘卡通艺术风格呈现。它以任务为基础，讲述了古怪的墨菲博士和反复出现的演员——安珀、拉娜、普法、雷帕和西尔维娅——经历了一系列轻松、荒诞的情节，场景之间穿插着解谜小游戏。
